scene: The vendor hands you a steaming bowl of glowing cyan broth.
picture: A flat side view along the steel bridge. On the far left, a vendor stands inside his wheeled soup cart. Left of centre, the player in his orange jacket holds a steaming cyan bowl. Beside him at centre rests the counter with spice bottles. Far right waits the yellow tram with open doors.
shown: The steaming bowl of cyan broth held in your hands at centre
Three labelled glass spice bottles sitting on the cart counter on the left
A bright yellow gear tram waiting open at the far right

variants.scene: A bowl of bright cyan soup warms your hands beneath the evening sky.
Neon steam rises from the glowing bowl while you hum {tune}.
The curious broth glows like blue starlight against your corduroy coat.
